what: Glass pill button — a 1px border of conic-gradient light (alternating faint 28% and 4%) over a gray glass background from 4% at top → 32% at bottom. On hover the light angle rotates 80°→95° (.6s), the background brightens and turns into 15px blurred glass, and a bright streak sweeps across the text from outside the left edge to the right end in .8s cubic-bezier(.25,.6,.3,1). The icon scales 1.3x .3s later, pressing scales .97x

options.--fx-angle: Rim light angle at rest, default 80deg (+15° on hover)
options.[data-fx-part=label]: Letters (span) the light beam passes over

from.where: shared.css .mr-btn (original .Button — --angle 80→95deg · glowTravel .8s cubic-bezier(.25,.6,.3,1) · svg scale 1.3 .3s later · :active .97)

note: In browsers that can’t read @property, the angle and light rays change in steps (the end shape is the same)
